'''Mekuun Corporation''' was known for its heavy [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Mekuun manufactured the [[High-Altitude Entry Transport-221/Legends|HAET-221]], and worked jointly with [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] to produce the [[Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport/Legends|UT-AT]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

A number of [[Repulsor coil/Legends|repulsor coils]] used to build their repulsorlifts were manufactured by [[Arden Repulsorlift Plant]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].
